scores.reasons: Gap high: no site, no menu, unclaimed profile. Ability to pay low-moderate: single-stylist salon with no history of web spend. Ease high: a one-page site plus booking tool is quick. Evidence moderate: strong on Google data, thin on services because nothing is published.

caveats: Google Maps rendered in a limited, signed-out view for this session: star ratings, hours and 'Add website'/'Claim this business' prompts were visible but review counts were not, so counts come from Birdeye/BestProsInTown/Healthgrades where available and are noted as such.
No forms were submitted anywhere. Where a booking widget or form existed (Create Your Core, Emy Beauty, Tabori) I stopped at the first screen and recorded only what was visible.

The Emy Beauty hero slider uses stock Unsplash images and rendered as a blank band in our browser; this may be the image host being blocked in the research environment rather than a site defect, so it is flagged as unconfirmed.
Create Your Core has moved from South River to Colts Neck; it is reported here under its batch town because the website, schema and most directories still give the South River address.
Zephyrine Dental Care could not be verified as an operating practice; the entry is kept for completeness but should be treated as unverified.
data_gaps: Review counts on Google could not be read for any business (limited Maps view); third-party counts vary by aggregator.

Zephyrine Dental Care: no phone, no staff names, no services, no operating evidence beyond an unclaimed Maps card; 62 Armstrong Ave appears in property listings as a residential address (unverified against borough records).
St Mina's Medical Center: what the clinic actually provides, who its providers are and whether it takes insurance are unknown - no source describes it.
Girgis Family Medicine: one directory lists 171 Main St Suite 4 (the same address as Tabori's dental office) instead of 123 Main St, so the physical suite could not be confirmed.
Mik Smile Dental: no services list, no staff names and no practice website exist; the insurer PDF listing languages was not opened directly (returned by search only).
La Belle Beauty Salon: the 'Book online' action on Google could not be traced to a specific booking platform without submitting a booking.
Emy Beauty: the exact Google review count is unavailable; directories disagree (54 vs 106).
Prices/price ranges are not published by any of the ten businesses except Tabori's 'specials', so price-range data is absent for agent readiness scoring.
